ぐすたふ的 C106 的本子，可惜没有扫图上传，C107 是续作，之前记得在评论区说过这本英文版是在 fanbox 上，需要赞助 1000 日元解锁，这都快一年过去了，也没见人上传，我就上传了，期待哪位大佬上传一下 c107 的续作，感激不尽。
It’s a pity that Gustaf’s C106 doujinshi was never scanned and uploaded. C107 is its sequel. I remember someone mentioning in the comments before that the English version of this C106 book is available on Fanbox, unlocked at the 1,000 yen tier. Since almost a year has passed and nobody else has shared it, I went ahead and uploaded it myself. I’m really hoping some kind soul will upload the C107 sequel as well. Huge thanks in advance!
ps：命名图片和按照顺序排序快给我累死了，太麻烦了
